title: Core Nonet #01
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, nine women in a single row.

A photograph of NINE women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 9 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[Yoruba bridal / USSBBW]: Yoruba Nigerian woman, late 20s, demure and soft, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, wavy hair, oval nails (glossy). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back. Shoes: extreme gold ankle-strap stilettos.

[Jamaican Dancehall Glam / Brazilian Booty]: Jamaican woman, mid 50s, demure and soft, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, elegant updo hair, almond nails (chrome). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: leaning one arm on a window frame. Shoes: extreme gold platform stiletto Mary Janes.
